rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for copying someone’s qualities or actions in order to match or surpass them.

example.english: My daily emulation of my senior's methods helps me improve.
example.traditional: 為咗追上師兄，我日日模仿佢嘅做法。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 zeoi1 soeng5 si1 hing1 ngo5 jat6 jat6 mou4 fong2 keoi5 ge3 zou6 faat3

rows.note: Use this specifically for software that reproduces the operation of another system.

example.english: This program uses emulation to reproduce the operation of an old computer.
example.traditional: 呢個程式可以模擬舊電腦嘅運作。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 mou4 ji4 gau6 din6 nou5 ge3 wan6 zok3
